In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HWMP is a good routing protocol and it is able to provide good routing performance for the WMN under heterogeneous traffic.
HWMP is not suitable for real time traffic and it is not suitable for the traffic with high data rate.
HWMP is suitable to be used in WMNs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the HWMP protocol is not a good choice for the real network with diverse application characteristics.
HWMP is a good protocol in terms of packet delivery ratio and average delay.
HWMP protocol can be used in a real wireless network with different application characteristics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of the routing protocol is highly sensitive to the characteristics of the traffic and the packet size of the traffic.
HWMP performs poorly for real network traffic and it is not suitable to use it in real network.
, HWMP protocol performs better for video application with large packets and low packet rate and performs worst for FTP and email application with smaller packet size and high packet rate.
